subject: Onboarding & leaver documentation request for SOC 2 quarterly audit
messages:
From: Gina Park <gina@greenleafsec.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding/leaver artifacts for SOC 2 Q2 review

Hi Soojin —

Acme's SOC 2 review team is kicking off our quarterly evidence collection. They asked for a small bundle focused on onboarding and termination controls to validate personnel access revocation and training completion. Specifically they requested: 

- Onboarding checklist template(s) used in the last 12 months
- Evidence that background checks are performed and how PII is redacted for SOC 2 delivery
- A redacted sample termination log showing access removal timestamps for at least 6 leavers in the last 12 months
- Attestation that security training was run for new hires and leavers (sample training rosters + dates)

Can you assemble a redacted bundle (PDF/CSV/Doc) and share a Drive link? Also flag any items that cannot be shared because of PII or vendor constraints so we can propose alternative evidence.

Thanks,
Gina Park
Greenleaf Security (external assessor)

---
Attachments: none
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Park <gina@greenleafsec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/leaver artifacts for SOC 2 Q2 review

Thanks Gina — I can pull this together. Quick clarifying questions so we scope it correctly: 

1) Date range: do you need the last 12 months or only the current fiscal year? We can easily provide 12 months but will need extra redactions for older records.
2) Background checks: Acme will receive redacted confirmation of check completion (vendor report + date). We do not share raw PII. Is a vendor attestation + sample redacted report acceptable?
3) Termination log: we have an internal CSV that shows username, role, termination_date, and access_revoked_at. We can redact usernames and provide a mapping key offline if required.

Planned delivery: initial bundle in Drive by Tue EOD (27 Apr). If that works I'll coordinate with HR (Marissa) and Ops (Vivek) and copy Neha for training rosters.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/leaver artifacts for SOC 2 Q2 review

Adding HR artifacts — attaching the onboarding template and the background-check redaction guidance we use with vendors.

Notes: 
- onboarding_template.csv (attached) is our canonical checklist that HR fills at offer acceptance and first day.
- background_check_redaction_guidance.docx (attached) shows how we redact SSNs and DOBs for auditor delivery.
- For terminations we will provide termination_log_redacted_q1-q2-2027.pdf; it includes role and access_revoked_at timestamps but replaces personal identifiers with employee IDs (hashed).

If Acme needs a signed attestation for background vendor practices, we can request a vendor-signed letter; that will add 1-2 business days.

Marissa Cole
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/leaver artifacts for SOC 2 Q2 review

Appreciate the quick responses. A couple of follow-ups from the Acme team: 

- Date range: please do last 12 months (rolling).
- For the termination log: hashed IDs are fine; please include a note describing the hashing approach (one-way salted hash preferred).
- Training rosters: we need at least two sampled new hires with proof-of-completion (screenshot or LMS export) and one leaver showing training status at time of termination.
- If any items require vendor letters (background check vendor, LMS provider), indicate expected lead time.

If possible, please share the Drive folder and a DocuSign attestation link where Redwood leadership can confirm the bundle. Deadline for our reviewers is Fri 30 Apr COB.

Thanks — Jordan
(On behalf of Acme Compliance Team)
